notes.title: 🚛 Dev Log – Small Towns Arrive in Truck World Australia
notes.content:
Welcome to a new dev log! 👋

Today we’d like to show you more work-in-progress locations - these are the small towns in the south, and yes, in the distance you can already spot the ocean.

📸 Here are some of the screenshots:

[h3]Road view with the ocean ahead[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/76699af9737fbe0b91aa6e8c4e997d7001cfb6cb.jpg[/img]

[h3]A small town street[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/cbe14b3868dc9b617b7c824cc8e7dbc6cbeb5073.jpg[/img]

[h3]House with a pickup truck[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/8a12ffc62d716d578c625b0430b3632385e4419d.jpg[/img]
We’ve already started replacing vehicles with more “Australian” models


[h3]Town overview from above[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/1276094a7a30156cff5427efc49e12329da2eae5.jpg[/img]
For now you’ll see colorful placeholder cubes, which will later turn into proper buildings, and desert patches that will be replaced with green fields


[h3]Road with streetlights[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/7b6f281b27c23308001b411b22387b9073d2e350.jpg[/img]

[h3]Parking lot with trucks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/d55719c84dbb2b37cad846026d0474036de4998c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Industrial facilities[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/c8d143fa059955b2de7abe45ca37441bc808f0e8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dirt road[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/07fa4dc3e4ac799aa8cd2dbd24fa6a518948387f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Grain storage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/090fead30bb49adb8291ef3db04ef8d49defbe69.jpg[/img]

Right now, much of our effort is going into expanding the game world. But we haven’t forgotten about the other mechanics: in the coming months, we’ll be showing you the implementation of key systems such as economy, contracts, and deliveries.
We’ve got many exciting announcements ahead, and since our team has grown over the past six months, development is moving faster than ever.

[h3]👉 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and tell your friends - it really helps us a lot![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1327040/Truck_World_Australia/

Thank you for your support, and see you on the roads of Australia! 🦘🛣️

notes.title: Improved Physics Now in the First Haul!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey truckers![/h3][p]We’ve just released the [b]first update[/b] for [i]Truck World: Australia – First Haul[/i]!
The highlight of this patch is the [b]improved truck handling and physics[/b].
[/p][p]We believe truck behavior is the core of any good simulator — so we’ve done our best to incorporate your feedback and make it feel better behind the wheel.
[b]Update[/b] brings more realistic and predictable handling — try it out and let us know what you think![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 What’s New in Update:[/h3][p]– Improved [b]steering responsiveness on gamepads[/b] at high speeds
– Fixed [b]inverted controls when reversing[/b] with a gamepad
– Fixed [b]camera stuttering at low FPS[/b]
– And of course, the [b]reworked truck physics[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know how it feels — your feedback helps us improve the game![/p][p]Thanks for playing and supporting [i]Truck World: Australia[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🔧 New Update — Now in Beta!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve prepared some important improvements and uploaded them to beta branches so we can test them together. You can help us out and be among the first to try the changes:

✅ What’s New in This Beta:

– Reworked truck physics: improved grip, reduced excessive sliding, better trailer behavior

🚀 How to Access the Beta:

[olist]
[*] Open Steam and right-click on the game in your Library
[*]     Select Properties → go to the Betas tab
[*]     Enter the appropriate private beta access code [h3]TWAFHpatchpreview[/h3]
[*]     Choose the corresponding beta branch from the dropdown list
[/olist]

After testing, don’t forget to switch back to the main branch to receive future updates!

notes.title: 🚛 Truck Handling & Physics Survey
notes.content:
Hi, truckers!

This is the Truck World Studio team. We've received a lot of feedback about the truck handling and physics in First Haul — and now we want to dive deeper to make the full version of the game better.

If you experienced any issues with controls, or noticed strange behavior from the truck or trailer — please take a moment to fill out our short survey.

👉 Survey link: [url=https://forms.gle/h2a8JbwsuV3p7vuv8]https://forms.gle/h2a8JbwsuV3p7vuv8[/url]

Thank you for playing Truck World: Australia – First Haul, sharing your thoughts, and supporting us. We’re already working on improvements!

See you on the road,
Truck World Studio

notes.title: 🚛 Truck World: Australia – First Haul launches June 3rd!
notes.content:
The prologue, Truck World: Australia – First Haul, will be available for free on June 3rd — get ready for your first long haul across the Australian outback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610481/e7e681be7fe5352b341f224af72227eb6c0c8036.jpg[/img]

[h2]🛠 Community-Driven Development[/h2]

First Haul is more than a demo — it’s our first step toward community-driven development. We want to build this game together with you — real truck sim fans.

Since early this year, we’ve been playtesting the prologue and improving every part of it based on feedback:
[list]
[*]     Support for 90%+ steering wheels
[*]     Improved truck physics
[*]     Multiple transmission configurations
[*]     Enhanced sounds and controls
[*]     Dozens of bug fixes and UI improvements
[/list]

[h2]🤝 Join the community[/h2]

We’re already discussing future playtests on our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4]Discord[/url] — and we plan to run them more frequently.

If you want to help shape the future of Truck World: Australia, join the tests, share your thoughts, and be heard. Your feedback truly makes a difference.

Thanks for your support — and see you on the roads of Australia! 🦘
